name: RTC Cluster Engine
description: Ported from RTCV's real RTC_ClusterEngine.GenerateUnit: reads a run of Chunk Size consecutive Precision-byte segments starting at a computed aligned address, then reorders those segments — Random shuffle, Reverse, Rotate Forwards/Backwards, or Overwrite them all with one — and writes them back to the same span. Unlike the Vector/Nightmare engines, this never invents a new byte value, it only rearranges bytes that were already there.
author: Ported from RTCV (RTC_ClusterEngine.cs) for RTCFS4A

parameters.label: Shuffle Type
parameters.description: Random: Fisher-Yates shuffle of the chunk's segments. Reverse: flips their order. Rotate Forwards/Backwards: rotates by Modifier steps. Overwrite: replaces every segment with one end segment (which end depends on Direction).

parameters.label: Direction
parameters.description: Only matters for Overwrite mode: Forwards uses the first segment in the chunk as the source; Backwards uses the last.

parameters.label: Chunk Size (segments)
parameters.description: How many Precision-byte segments make up each shuffled chunk. Use the number box next to the slider for exact values.

parameters.label: Modifier
parameters.description: Number of rotation steps for Rotate Forwards/Backwards. Unused by the other shuffle types.

parameters.label: Segment Size (bytes)
parameters.description: Size of each segment being shuffled. RTCV normally reads this from a curated per-game Limiter List; pick it directly here instead.

parameters.label: Blast Count
parameters.description: How many random chunk-shuffles to perform. Use the number box next to the slider for exact values.

parameters.label: Alignment
parameters.description: Sub-offset added after rounding down to Segment Size, exactly as in the original: safeAddress = address - (address % precision) + alignment.

parameters.label: Start Byte
parameters.description: -1 = auto (right after Header Size below). Stands in for RTCV's per-game Limiter List, which restricts which addresses are eligible.

parameters.label: Header Size
parameters.description: Bytes to leave alone at the start of the file when Start Byte is -1. 16 for .nes/.fds, 512 for headered .smc, 0 for a headerless ROM.

parameters.label: Use Fixed Seed
parameters.description: Reuse the same seed to reproduce identical corruption on identical input.
